mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the rise in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint movement in UNRATE and PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) slows down by more than 1% YoY and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition of GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.
